result.topic_en: Above a draft note announcing a private lecture course on elliptic and Abelian functions, the page holds calculations of jump (shock) conditions for a one-dimensional gas flow: velocity and density ratios across discontinuities, shock speeds, and the quantities p = x'/a + s and q = x'/a − s with s = log density.

methods.what: Velocity jump across a discontinuity expressed via the density ratio α
Mass conservation across a discontinuity giving the shock speed
Shock speed for the first case
Shock speed for the second case
Riemann-type quantities p and q (velocity/a plus or minus log density) evaluated in each region
Piecewise-constant solution regions separated by the lines x = −at and x = at/α
